L01_female.wav.speaker: female
L01_female.wav.text: Good morning! Could I see your passport and ticket, please?

L02_male.wav.speaker: male
L02_male.wav.text: Sure, here you go. Can I check these two bags to Chicago?

L03_female.wav.speaker: female
L03_female.wav.text: Certainly. Please place them on the scale one at a time.

L04_male.wav.speaker: male
L04_male.wav.text: All right. I hope they are not over the weight limit.

L05_female.wav.speaker: female
L05_female.wav.text: Both are within the limit, but your gate has been changed to B12.

L06_male.wav.speaker: male
L06_male.wav.text: Oh, really? Did they announce that just a moment ago?

L07_female.wav.speaker: female
L07_female.wav.text: Yes, it is about a ten-minute walk from security.

L08_male.wav.speaker: male
L08_male.wav.text: Got it. What time will boarding start for this flight?

L09_female.wav.speaker: female
L09_female.wav.text: Boarding begins at two thirty, so please be there early.

L10_male.wav.speaker: male
L10_male.wav.text: Thank you for letting me know. Have a wonderful day!
